data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross reserve strengthening of GBP 35.579 million in 2018, primarily due to adverse claims development. This was influenced by an increase in the number and severity of large losses, particularly in Marine Hull, Marine Cargo, Property, Excess Casualty, and Healthcare lines of business. The 2017 net claims ratio was significantly impacted by hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, which also led to cash calls for the 2016 and 2017 years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: The `exact_reserve_text` for prior year development refers to the line item in the Technical Provisions table on page 49, as no direct narrative explicitly stating the gross prior year development amount was found. The narrative on page 40 refers to the net adverse movement. The `prior_year_events` section uses net adverse movements by LOB for 2017 as presented in the table on page 40, as gross figures for specific LOB prior year movements were not available. LOB movements could not be extracted as the report only provided net movements by L2 LOB, and the rule requires gross movements.
